Experience and past performance: The bidder should have manufactured and supplied at least 5400 liters of chemicals in any one of the last f

ive years ending on 31.03.2026. 2. Capability: The bidder must have an annual capacity to manufacture and supply at least 5400 liters of chemicals. 3. Financial Standing: The average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31.03.2026 shou ld be at least Rs. 17,75,468.00/-, as per the annual report of the relevant period, duly authenticated by a C hartered Accountant/ Cost Accountant in India. i) The net worth of the Bidder should not be negative on 31.03.2026. ii) The net worth of the firm should not have eroded by more than 30% in the last three years, ending on 3 1.03.2026. Note: (a) In support of above, the bidder should produce copies of purchase orders, experience certificates, j ob completion certificates of customer as a documentary evidence. (b) In support of financial standing, the bidders shall enclose attested copies of audited balance sheet Profit and loss account /Trading account certified by Chartered Accountant for the Completed three fin ancial year i.e. for 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. (c) Bidder to furnish stipulated documents support of fulfillment of qualifying criteria. Non submission or incomplete submission of documents may lead to rejection of offer. (d) For MSE & Start-up firm (registered for the tendered items) ‘Experience & Past Performance’ and all financial criteria shall be exempted. However, its capacity & capability may be verified (if necessary) b y the Currency Note Press, Nashik. (e) All experience, past performance and capacity/ capability related data should be certified by the au thorized signatory of the bidder firm. F. No. 6/18/2019-PPD dated 23rd/24th July 2020 or any further amendments thereof). IV) PAN AND Goods & Services Tax Registration (GST): The bidder should be registered with the inc ome Tax. Relevant Proof in support shall be submitted. VII) Payment Terms: Payments will be made for each installment after acceptance of Goods and product ion of all required documents certified by competent authority for Currency Note Press, Nashik Road on pr o-rata basis. VIII) Evaluation Method: The total price quoted for all items shall be considered for evaluation after RA t o decide L-1 bidder. Note : Before issue of order on GeM on successful firm " Notification of Award of Contract" will be issued o n firm duly requesting to deposit the performance security within 15 days (as per GeM) XI) Contact Details: Email: purchase.cnpnashik@spmcil.com XII) Bidder must submit check list of below mentioned documents as per Buyer added bid Spe cific ATC:- Sr. No. Description 1 Documentary evidence towards Qualification/Eligibility Criteria as per Clause II of Buyer Add ed Bid Specific ATC. 2 Undertaking's towards clause III of Buyer added bid specific ATC 3 Documentary evidence towards GST Registration Certificate & PAN Card of Bidder 4 Documentary evidence against payment of EMD. 5 Duly signed and Sealed Technical Specification as an acceptance. 6 Any other document as per tender, if required.
